name: Canvas Entity Reference
description: Adds entity reference support for Canvas component props. Supports any entity type via x-entity-type JSON Schema annotation, with built-in definitions for taxonomy terms, nodes, users, media, and block content.
project_description: Canvas Entity Reference extends the Canvas (Experience Builder) prop system so that Single-Directory Component props can reference Drupal content entities. A component author declares an entity reference prop directly in the component's .component.yml by adding an x-entity-type JSON Schema annotation (or the legacy taxonomy-term-reference $ref URI), and the module auto-wires it to an entity_reference field with the correct storage settings, handler, widget, cardinality, and Canvas live-preview transforms. No custom field configuration or PHP is required. Built-in definitions cover taxonomy_term, node, user, media, and block_content, and any other entity type works via x-entity-type. Per-prop annotations control which field value is returned (x-entity-field), which bundles are selectable (x-entity-type-bundles), and which widget is used (x-entity-widget). A settings form configures the default single-value widget, target vocabularies, and optional auto-creation of taxonomy terms. An entity_render() Twig function lets component templates render a referenced entity in a chosen view mode. The module is experimental and ships several example test components.
